author: Colleen Hoover
notes: Colleen Hoover’s 'It Ends With Us' is a deeply emotional contemporary romance novel that tackles themes of love, abuse, and personal strength through the story of a woman navigating a complex relationship. The film adaptation has been a hot topic among Hoover’s massive fanbase, with Sony Pictures aiming to capture the raw intensity of the book following delays from its initial release window. Blake Lively stars as Lily Bloom, with Justin Baldoni, who also directs, playing Ryle Kincaid, ensuring a personal touch to this sensitive material. Production faced setbacks but is now complete, with a confirmed summer 2026 release. I recommend reading the book first, as its first-person perspective and gut-wrenching emotional depth may not fully translate to film, and knowing the story beforehand will enhance the viewing experience.
